title: fix(lint): field-path rules judge an object as served, so a field an objectExtensions entry adds is not refused (#30383)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3fsAozd9DYHnPe5HXgoWeN)_

Fixes #30383

Clause-②: yes (widening: field-path rules accept fields a sibling package adds through `objectExtensions`, which the runtime already serves; any rule that deliberately stays on declared fields says why in its header)
Metadata-protocol: none (lint judgements, no authorable key)
Skills-docs: none owed — no skill, eval or doc teaches that a view, report, dataset, page, widget, mapping, related list or row policy may not name an extension field (`git grep -c -E "dataset-field-unknown|list-view-field-unknown|rls-predicate-unknown-field|related-list-ref-unknown|mapping-target-field-unknown|page-field-unknown|widget-filter-field-unknown" -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/releases'`: 1 hit, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx:267`, which names no extension; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md:156` refuses a membership key on an extension, a rule this PR does not touch)
Prior rulings read: objectextensions,indexobjectgraph,objectsasserved → 2 hits; ADR-0029 D3, ADR-0146 D10; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：卡上 12 条字段路径 lint 规则（数据集、报表筛选、仪表盘部件、列表视图、对象自身字段列表、页面绑定、预设比较值、RLS、共享规则、感谢页、度量聚合、字段消费者）和 2 个私有扩展读取器（相关列表、导入映射），全部改读 #30359 落地的同一份共享折叠：对象按注册表实际提供的样子判断，即声明字段加上同一制品中任何包通过 `objectExtensions` 加的字段。
- 为什么改：多包制品（HotCRM 的模块包给 app 包的对象加字段）里，视图、报表、数据集、页面、部件只要引用扩展字段就被 lint 判为未知字段并拒绝，而运行时明明提供这个字段。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽拒绝面；真不存在的字段照旧报原规则 id、级别、消息（逐字节钉住）。按类型判断的规则现在会按扩展字段的实际类型判断；两个包在同一优先级写同一字段时，胜者取决于注册顺序，这些类型判断对该字段不下结论，感谢页则只在所有写法都是引擎生成类型时才放行。相关列表对本栈未声明的对象不当作子对象判断（逐包检查时它的声明在别的包里）。showcase 全量实测 14 条规则前后发现完全一致。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` 文件末尾新增的 `indexServedObjectGraph` 与 `objectsWithoutTiedFields`；`validate-related-list-refs.ts` 与 `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` 两个私有读取器的删除；`object-graph.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#30383]` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/object-graph.test.ts`，预期 89 例全绿（其中 42 例为本 PR 新增）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`object-graph.ts`, two helpers at the end of the file:** `indexServedObjectGraph(stack, { tied })`, `indexObjectGraph` over `objectsAsServed(stack).objects`; and `objectsWithoutTiedFields(served)`, the served objects less every field in `served.tied`. Neither is exported from the package entry. They sit below the fold's section on purpose: `foldCode()` in `validate-security-posture.test.ts` (:1656-1665) appends `object-graph.ts`'s text from `export interface VisibleObjectExtension` to `/** What a path resolved to` to the posture rule's code, and holds every receiver read there to its tables; these two read only the fold's output. The shared fold (`objectExtensionsByTarget`, `objectsAsServed`) itself is unchanged.
- **Twelve rules now resolve through the served objects** (table below). Rules that build a second index beside the graph (list-view option values, widget field types, page field names) build it from the same served objects, so the two indexes of one rule cannot disagree.
- **Tied fields** (`objectsAsServed(...).tied`: two packages write one field at the deciding priority). The registry registers packages in dependency-topological order (`resolveArtifactPackageOrder`), not `packages[]` order, so which definition is served cannot be read off the stack. Every rule still accepts the tied field's name. The type arms leave it unjudged: measure aggregates and preset comparands index `{ tied: 'drop' }`, the sharing rule's condition graph and the widget field-type map and kanban option map are built from `objectsWithoutTiedFields`. The thank-you rule fails closed instead: a tied field passes only when every writer at the deciding priority has an engine-generated type.
- **Two private readers retired onto the shared fold:**
  - `validate-related-list-refs.ts`: its fold read the stack's top-level `objectExtensions` only, and only the map form of `fields`. It now reads `objectsAsServed` for the children this stack declares, every field read by name in either shape. An object this stack does not declare is not a child even when an extension targets it: on the per-package leg its declaration and foreign keys may live in a package the leg does not carry, so it falls to the unknown-child rule as before (header says so).
  - `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts`: `extensionFieldsByTarget` (top level plus every body, every entry kept) is deleted; the object is judged as served. The ruled refusal of a present non-array `packages` (ruling A on #15293) stays, asked through `packagesOf` once, since the fold reads such a value as absent.
- **`validate-field-consumers.ts` header**: extension-added fields are still not judged themselves, but a dataset or cube path through an extension-added relationship now credits the declared field it reaches.
- **Tests**: one top-level describe in `object-graph.test.ts`, the fold's harness (42 tests): for each existence rule an extension-added field passes, the same stack without the extension refuses, and a field nothing adds is refused with byte-equal severity, `where`, path and message to a declared-only control; the per-package leg (`packageBodyAsStack`'s shape) for the existence rules and for related lists; a nested describe for a field two packages tie on, one test per tie-dropping arm, each tied pair listing last the definition the arm would refuse (the one the fold keeps), with a single-writer control of that definition refused; `validate-mapping-target-fields.test.ts`'s extension fixture rewritten to the two shapes the registry reads (see Acceptance notes).
- `.changeset/30383-field-path-rules-extension-fields.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch.

### Per rule

All on one artifact: an app package declares `xs_deal`, a module package extends it with `region`, `score`, `closed_on`, `ref_no`, `partner`, and extends `xs_note` with a lookup to `xs_deal`.

| Rule | Moved or kept | Why | Pin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `validate-dataset-references.ts` | moved (`indexServedObjectGraph`) | the dataset compiler queries the served object | `ref_no` and `partner.tier` pass; without the extension `dataset-field-unknown`; `nowhere`, `partner.nowhere` still `dataset-field-unknown` |
| `validate-report-runtime-filter.ts` | moved | same compiler | `ref_no` passes, refused without the extension; `nowhere` still `report-filter-field-unknown` |
| `validate-widget-bindings.ts` | moved (graph, field-type map without ties) | same | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `widget-filter-field-unknown`; SUM over a `number`/`percent` tie is not `measure-aggregate-incoherent`, over `percent` alone it is |
| `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` | moved (graph, kanban option map without ties) | the list door queries the served object | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `list-view-field-unknown`; a lane `b` on a select tied between options `a,b` and `a,c` is not judged, on `a,c` alone it is `list-view-kanban-lane-unknown` |
| `validate-object-field-refs.ts` | moved | the record page reads the served object | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `object-field-ref-unknown` |
| `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` | moved, last (graph and field-name index) | the renderer binds the served object | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `page-field-unknown` |
| `validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts` | moved | the RLS compiler compiles against the served object; the maintainer's hotcrm#2315 ruling gives a module's extension fields their access in the app package's permission sets | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `rls-predicate-unknown-field` |
| `validate-thank-you-record-fields.ts` | moved, ties fail closed | the panel renders the inserted served record | an extension `autonumber` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `thank-you-record-field`; a tie between `autonumber` and `text` is refused |
| `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` | moved, private reader retired | the import door writes the served object | `ref_no` passes, refused without; `nowhere` still `mapping-target-field-unknown`; one entry per package per target |
| `validate-related-list-refs.ts` | moved, private reader retired | the record page derives related lists from served fields | an FK a sibling package adds passes, bare and as `object.field`; refused without; `xs_note.nowhere` still `related-list-ref-unknown`; one entry per package per target; on the per-package leg a body extending another package's undeclared object raises nothing |
| `validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` | moved (type arm, ties dropped) | judges the served type | SUM over extension `score` passes, over extension `region` is `measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`; `nowhere` stays the existence rule's; a tied `score` is not judged |
| `validate-preset-comparands.ts` | moved (type arm, ties dropped) | judges the served type | `closed_on: 'last_30_days'` on an extension date is `filter-preset-comparand`; on extension text it passes |
| `validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts` | moved (type arm without ties, anchor served) | the driver judges the criteria query against the served object; a `controlled_by_parent` anchor's master is read as the security posture rule's merge (#23210) reads it | `record.region == record.name` passes; `record.closed_on == record.name` is `sharing-rule-unlowerable-condition` |
| `validate-field-consumers.ts` | moved for resolution; extension fields still not judged | crediting a path the runtime serves | `partner.tier` credits `xs_account.tier`; without that path `tier` is `field-no-consumers`; no finding on any extension-added field |

No rule stays on declared fields. The two security rules were weighed: the RLS rule's only verdict on an extension field was a false `rls-predicate-unknown-field`, and the sharing rule's type arm judges what the driver judges at query time, so neither has a security reason to read the declared anchor.

## Why

The runtime serves each object with every body's `objectExtensions` folded in, but these rules indexed `stack.objects` only, so on a multi-package artifact (HotCRM, hotcrm#2315: a module package adds fields to an app package's object) a view, report, dataset, page or widget naming an extension-added field was refused as unknown. #30303 (PR #30359) added the shared fold and moved the FLS-key check onto it; this PR moves the rest of the census onto the same fold.

## Verification

All at head `806dd06b`, under `os-verify-lock`, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: Test Files 194 passed (194), Tests 8063 passed (8063); `check:test-typecheck: OK`; VERDICT command-exit 0. `object-graph.test.ts`: 89 passed (89).
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` over the 17 changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
- Before/after on the showcase (`examples/app-showcase`, which carries top-level `objectExtensions`), measured at `e27387e2`: each of the 14 rules run on the loaded config with the `origin/main` copy and with that head. Every rule's finding set (rule, path, where, message) is identical, 49 `field-no-consumers` warnings and 0 of every other id on both sides. Probe files deleted. The rework narrows only what that head accepted (an undeclared related-list child, a tied field's type), and the showcase has neither.

<details><summary>Reverse verification (restored to the HEAD blob each time)</summary>

- Round 1, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `indexServedObjectGraph`'s body back to `indexObjectGraph(stack)` (anchor 1 → 0): `object-graph.test.ts` went **9 failed | 54 passed (63)**, exactly the pins of the eight rules routed through the helper. The other six rules read `objectsAsServed` directly; each of their pins asserts the same stack without the extension still refuses, so none is vacuous.
- Rework, related lists (at `31eef372`): `validate-related-list-refs.ts` set back to its `e27387e2` blob: the new per-package-leg pin goes red (**1 failed | 84 passed (85)**, a false `related-list-ref-unknown` on the undeclared target); restored.
- Rework, ties: `objectsWithoutTiedFields`'s first line made to return `served.objects` unconditionally: **5 failed | 84 passed (89)**, one per arm: measure aggregates, preset comparands, sharing-rule criteria, the widget field-type map, the kanban option map. The thank-you pin stays green, as it should: that rule reads `tied` itself and fails closed. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty. (`ablation-replace.mjs` refuses a replacement that keeps its anchor, so this one was applied and restored by hand, the blob checked equal to HEAD after.)
- The lint tests import `src`, so no dist sat between mutation and run.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `806dd06b`: 59 derived families, the same set as at `a7e08193`. Each run serially with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`; record `/mnt/project-files/issue-30383/gates-ran.list`, every line `exit 0` on the first pass, `check-changeset-no-major` included.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm: no full dogfood run. CI owns the rest of the farm.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured differences of the two retired readers.** (1) `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` read the top-level `objectExtensions` beside `packages[]`; the registry reads only the bodies when an artifact carries `packages[]` (its top level repeats them). The old test fixture put `sla_tier` at the top level only, beside a `packages[]`, a shape no CLI leg produces (the per-package leg hands the body's own entries in its `packages[]` entry too); it is rewritten to the two shapes the registry reads. (2) Both readers kept every entry; the fold keeps one per package per target, so a field only a package's earlier, replaced entry adds is now refused, as the registry serves it (pinned). (3) The related-list reader read only the map form of `fields`; the array form is now read too. (4) The related-list reader made an undeclared object reached by a top-level extension a judged child; that is dropped, so such an object falls to the unknown-child rule, as it does for any undeclared object. On the showcase none of these changes a finding.
- **Tied fields inside existence rules.** The existence rules accept a tied field's name. Where an existence rule also asks a type question of the graph (RLS list-holding and cross-class checks, a list view's dotted head, a page count's multi-value check, a dataset hop), it reads the definition the fold kept, the one `objectsAsServed` returns; only the type arms named above drop ties. Narrowing those too would need the graph to carry a tie per field, a change to the shared index this card leaves alone.
- **Census, wider than the card** (by reading; not reproduced per rule, ⛔ not changed here; carried to the seat):
  - `validate-translation-references.ts` keeps a third private `objectExtensionsByTarget` (top level plus every body, every entry kept). It also folds validation rules, which the shared fold does not carry, so it was not moved.
  - Field-name indexes outside `indexObjectGraph` still read declared objects only: `validate-expressions.ts` (`buildFieldIndex`, the `record.FIELD` reads of validations, formulas, flows, hooks and sharing-rule conditions), `indexObjectFields` in `validate-react-page-props.ts`, `validate-flow-node-writes.ts` and `validate-action-body-writes.ts`, and the own copy in `validate-hook-body-writes.ts`. Open PR #30270 moves page sorts to `validate-sortable-fields.ts`, which at its head reads declared objects only (`recordsOf(stack.objects)`, line 508); carried with the others.
  - `defineStack`'s twin, `collectRelatedListNameErrors` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, folds every entry additively; lint is now the stricter of the two on the replaced-entry case only.
- `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` was moved last; open draft PR #30270 edits the same file in hunks this PR does not touch.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint over the changed files: exit 0; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block excepted, per project convention).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
